products.name: AURORA PORK HEART
products.description: Premium frozen pork heart, rich red color and firm texture. Commonly used for stews, barbecue, and pulutan dishes. Store at -18 °C.

products.name: FRIBOI PATA
products.description: High-quality pork hind leg (pata), ideal for crispy pata and braised dishes. Frozen and vacuum-packed for freshness.

products.name: HATFIELD EARS
products.description: Cleaned and trimmed pork ears, excellent for sisig, grilled specialties, and snacks. Delivered frozen in food-grade sealed packaging.

products.name: SEARA BELLY BISO
products.description: Premium pork belly “biso cut,” featuring balanced layers of lean meat and fat. Perfect for liempo, roasting, or frying.

products.name: PERDIGAO LACONE
products.description: Frozen pork neck/shoulder cut (“lacone”) suitable for stews and braised recipes. Frozen to preserve quality. Ideal for restaurants and bulk buyers.

products.name: COOPER JOWLS
products.description: Pork jowls (cheek meat) with good marbling and tenderness. Commonly used for smoked, grilled, or cured pork dishes. Supplied frozen for consistent quality.

products.name: ALLIANCE BEEF TENDER LOIN
products.description: Premium-grade beef tenderloin, boneless and lean, ideal for steaks and roasts. Imported and vacuum-sealed for maximum freshness.

products.name: AMECO BEEF SHANK
products.description: Beef shank with bone and rich marrow, perfect for bulalo, soups, and stews. Packed frozen to ensure consistent quality.

products.name: INGHAMS BONE MARROW
products.description: Frozen beef bone marrow cuts, ideal for roasting or making flavorful broth. Vacuum-packed for freshness.

products.name: BEEF BONE BRISKET
products.description: Premium beef brisket with bone, perfect for smoking, braising, or stewing. Frozen and packed for consistent cut quality.

products.name: FRIBOI FOREQUARTER
products.description: Frozen beef forequarter cut including chuck and rib portions. Used for ground beef, stews, or braised dishes. Supplied frozen, ideal for bulk buyers.

products.name: AURORA WINGS
products.description: Fresh-frozen chicken wings, trimmed and portioned for easy preparation. Great for frying or glazing. Blast-frozen for quality.

products.name: INGHAM CHICKEN FEET
products.description: Cleaned chicken feet, perfect for dim sum or soup base. Frozen immediately after processing to ensure safety.

products.name: AJC CHICKEN LIVER
products.description: Fresh-frozen chicken liver, rich in flavor and iron. Excellent for adobo, spreads, or pâté.

products.name: MONTAIRE GIZZARD
products.description: Frozen chicken gizzard, trimmed and cleaned for convenience. Great for adobo or stir-fry dishes.

products.name: AJC CLQ
products.description: Whole dressed chicken (CLQ grade), frozen and vacuum-sealed to preserve freshness. Ideal for roasting or portioning.

products.name: BEEF SHANK CUTTED
products.description: Sliced beef shank portions with bone and tendon, ready for soup or stew preparation. Great for bulalo or nilaga.

products.name: MONDELLI BEEF TRIMMINGS
products.description: Frozen beef trimmings ideal for ground beef or burger processing. Uniform quality and texture.

products.name: PATA FRONT CUTTED
products.description: Front leg pork slices (pata cut), trimmed and portioned. Great for crispy pata or sinigang.

products.name: LITERA PORK HEAD CUTTED
products.description: Pork head meat, cut into manageable portions for sisig or other Filipino dishes. Frozen and vacuum-sealed for freshness.

products.name: PORK CHOP BISO
products.description: Pork chop “biso” slices, well-trimmed and evenly cut. Ideal for frying or grilling.

products.name: FRENCH FRIES
products.description: Pre-cut frozen French fries, ready to fry. Made from high-quality potatoes, individually quick-frozen (IQF) for crispness.

products.name: TJ HOTDOG CLASSIC
products.description: Classic pork and beef hotdog, juicy and flavorful. Fully cooked and frozen for convenience.

products.name: PORK SIOMAI
products.description: Ready-to-cook pork siomai dumplings made from seasoned pork filling wrapped in thin dough. Ideal for restaurants or canteens.

products.name: BEEF SIOMAI
products.description: Premium beef siomai with rich flavor and tender texture. Ready for steaming or frying.

products.name: CHICKEN SIOMAI
products.description: Light and tasty chicken siomai, fully seasoned and ready to cook. Ideal for bulk sale or food stalls.

products.name: OLYMEL CREAM DORY FILLET
products.description: Premium frozen cream dory (Pangasius) fillets, skinless and boneless. Mild flavor and delicate flaky texture, ideal for grilling, pan-searing, baking, or steaming.

products.name: SEARA SQUID RINGS
products.description: Frozen squid rings (calamari), cleaned and portioned uniformly. Ideal for deep frying, sautéing, breading, or tempura.

products.name: OLYMEL SCALLOPS
products.description: Premium sea scallop meat, creamy white flesh. Suitable for sashimi, searing, grilling, or buttery sauce preparations. Vacuum-sealed and blast frozen for freshness.

faqs.question: What are your delivery areas?
faqs.answer: We deliver to all areas within Metro Manila and selected provinces. Please contact us to confirm delivery availability in your area.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard delivery takes 1-2 business days for Metro Manila and 2-3 business days for provincial areas. Express delivery options are available.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept cash on delivery, bank transfers, credit/debit cards, and digital wallets for your convenience.

faqs.question: How can I track my order?
faqs.answer: You can track your order by logging into your account and going to the 'Track Orders' section. You'll receive updates via email and SMS.

faqs.question: What if I'm not satisfied with my order?
faqs.answer: We offer a replacement request system. You can submit a replacement request within 24 hours of delivery if you're not satisfied with the quality of your order.

faqs.question: How do I place an order?
faqs.answer: Simply browse our products, add items to your cart, proceed to checkout, provide your delivery information, and complete payment. It's that easy!

faqs.question: Are your products fresh?
faqs.answer: Yes, we guarantee fresh, high-quality meat products. All our products are sourced from trusted suppliers and delivered fresh to your doorstep.

faqs.question: What are your business hours?
faqs.answer: We operate Monday to Friday from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. We're closed on Sundays.

faqs.question: How can I contact customer support?
faqs.answer: You can contact us through our live chat feature, email at info@roselmeat.com, or call us at +63 926 320 3832.

faqs.question: Do you offer bulk orders?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer special pricing for bulk orders. Please contact us directly to discuss your requirements and get a custom quote.
